steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: Reach out to our specialist for a free consultation. We review your documents, experience and goals, and recommend the best direction.
substeps: Analysis of personal details and experience
Identifying suitable countries and job types
Information on estimated timelines and costs

steps.title: Document preparation
steps.description: Our document specialists prepare all the required papers in the right order. Passport, diplomas, employment record, medical certificates and more.

steps.title: Visa application
steps.description: The right application is filled in depending on the visa type and country. We also arrange the consulate visit and prepare you for the interview.
substeps: Determining the visa type (work, D, Schengen, etc.)
Filling in the online application and collecting the document package
steps.note: Visa timelines vary by country. Contact us for exact terms.

steps.title: Employment contract
steps.description: We place you with our partner companies abroad. Contract terms, salary, housing and other benefits are agreed in advance.
steps.note: Contact us for exact information about salary, working hours and housing.

steps.title: Departure
steps.description: We give detailed instructions on what to do on travel day. Airport pickup, first accommodation and starting work.
substeps: Practical guidance for the first days

steps.title: Settling in & Monitoring
steps.description: We provide ongoing support while you adapt to the new country. Help with opening a bank account, local registration, health insurance and more.

warnings: Your passport must be valid for at least 12 months
All details in your documents must be correct and consistent
Medical certificates are only issued by accredited clinics
Don't go through unknown intermediaries — risk of fraud
Don't pay money before an employment contract is signed
docs: Employment record book or experience document
